name: 无形资产（商标/专利/评估）方法

map.无形资产评估工具，采用收益法计算无形资产价值，通过超额收益和资本化率确定评估值，: An intangible asset valuation tool using the income approach, capitalizing excess earnings to value trademarks, patents and other intangibles.
map.📖 查看「无形资产（商标/专利/评估）方法 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Intangible Asset Valuation (Trademark / Patent) User Guide"
map.无形资产评估 = 收益/市场/成本法: Intangible valuation = income / market / cost approach
map.无形资产评估常用收益法、市场法和成本法三种方法: Intangible valuation commonly uses the income, market and cost approaches
map.收益法核心是计算超额收益并折现: The income approach centers on computing excess earnings and discounting them
map.商标保护期10年(可续展)，专利发明20年/实用新型10年: Trademark protection runs 10 years (renewable), invention patents 20 years and utility models 10 years
map.折现率一般取10%-15%，风险越高折现率越大: Discount rates are usually 10%-15% and rise with risk
map.商标、专利、著作权许可费或转让时估算价值。: Value trademarks, patents and copyrights for licensing or transfer.
map.商誉减值测试时测算超额收益现值。: Measure the present value of excess earnings in goodwill impairment testing.
map.特许经营权按收益期限折现。: Discount franchise rights over their income period.
map.年营收 500 万、超额: Annual revenue of 5 million yuan with an excess
map.15% → 超额利润 75 万；所得税 25% → 税后 56.25 万；折现率: of 15% gives excess profit of 750,000; income tax at 25% leaves 562,500 after tax; at a 12% discount rate in perpetuity, value = 56.25/0.12 = 4.6875 million yuan.
map.若收益期限 10 年、折现率 12% → 价值=56.25×(1−1.12^−1: With a 10-year income period and a 12% discount rate, value = 56.25 × (1−1.12^−10)/0.12 ≈ 56.25 × 5.65 ≈ 3.178 million yuan, about 1.5 million below the perpetual case.
map.无形资产风险高于有形资产，折现率通常取 10%–15%，并考虑法律保护期与经济寿: Intangibles carry more risk than tangibles, so rates are usually 10%-15%, allowing for legal protection period and economic life.
map.用有该资产与无该资产的利润差，或行业平均利润率之上的部分，需有可比基准而非主观假: Use the profit difference with and without the asset, or the margin above the industry average; a comparable benchmark is needed rather than a subjective assumption.
map.无形资产评估工具采用收益法计算商标、专利、著作权、特许经营权和商誉等无形资产价值: The tool values trademarks, patents, copyrights, franchise rights and goodwill by the income approach, capitalizing excess earnings at a discount rate.
